items.title: Complete Sauna Vent Kit
items.description: The Sauna Vent Kit is an essential accessory designed to help regulate airflow and ventilation in your sauna. This kit includes a wooden panel and metal plates with perforated holes that are installed in the sauna walls. This allows for easy adjustment of airflow by rotating the wooden panel to cover or uncover the holes, allowing for better control over the temperature and humidity inside the sauna. Typically installed in two locations within the sauna, the vent kit helps maintain optimal air circulation, ensuring a comfortable and safe sauna experience.

items.title: Quick-Connect Set
items.description: Upgrade your cold plunge setup with the Quick Connect Set , designed for fast, secure, and hassle free installation. This complete set includes hoses, ball valves, and a pre filter , giving you everything needed to connect your plunge to your chiller while maintaining strong water flow and helping protect your system from debris. The quick connect design makes setup, maintenance, and disconnection simple, while the ball valves allow you to shut off water flow when servicing or cleaning your system. Includes: Hoses Ball valves Pre filter Quick connect fittings Ideal for replacing an existing connection set or completing a new Coldture cold plunge setup.
